nameOrigin: a small mammal with long ears

pokedexEntries.sw: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

pokedexEntries.sh: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

pokedexEntries.sc: Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily heat up its fire energy and produce flames with more power.

pokedexEntries.vi: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.
